title: Thread rolling of stud bolts from STA rod stock
description: Thread rolling of stud bolts from STA rod stock capability for titanium components
processDescription: Thread rolling cold-forms threads by displacing material between two reciprocating or rotary dies, rather than cutting it away. Compressive residual stress at the thread root increases fatigue strength by 30–50% compared to cut threads, specifically for titanium components. Precision titanium components present unique challenges: balancing dimensional accuracy with cost per part. Process selection (mill vs. turn vs. EDM vs. laser) is optimized for each feature.
heatControl: Cold forming process — no heat generated. Water-soluble lubricant applied to dies for galling prevention on titanium.
flatnessControl: Head flatness and perpendicularity within 0.05 mm per fastener standards. Die alignment verified with optical setup microscope.
capabilitiesDescription: Fastener manufacturing capability for Thread rolling of stud bolts from STA rod stock, with cold forming, thread rolling, and 100% dimensional inspection.
